name: Banarasi Silk Saree
description: A rich silk saree with zari work, best for grand Indian occasions and traditional styling.
styling_tips: Pair with a zari or brocade blouse.
Use temple jewellery or kundan accessories.
Keep the blouse structured for a premium look.

name: Pastel Organza Saree
description: A lightweight, sheer saree that gives a soft modern look for daytime or semi-formal events.
styling_tips: Pair with pearl-work, sequin, or sleeveless blouses.
Choose dewy makeup and minimal jewellery.
Works well for modern wedding guest looks.

name: Embellished Georgette Saree
description: A flowy saree with light shimmer or embellishment, ideal for evening events and party styling.
styling_tips: Pair with a strappy, corset, or sequinned blouse.
Statement earrings work better than heavy necklaces.
Add heels for a sharper silhouette.

name: Cotton Linen Saree
description: A breathable and polished saree for workwear, casual outings, or simple daytime dressing.
styling_tips: Pair with a boat-neck, collared, or printed cotton blouse.
Use oxidised jewellery or a simple watch.
Keep pleats crisp for a clean workwear look.

name: Soft Chiffon Saree
description: A light drapey saree that creates a graceful silhouette and is easy to carry.
styling_tips: Pair with a sweetheart, halter, or simple sleeveless blouse.
Choose soft curls or a clean bun.

name: Yellow Floral Saree
description: A cheerful lightweight saree suited for haldi, mehendi, and daytime family functions.
styling_tips: Pair with a floral, mirror-work, or sleeveless blouse.
Use floral jewellery or oxidised accessories.
Keep the drape comfortable for movement.
